features.name: Equity-Aware Re-ranking
features.description: Re-rank candidates based on similarity and link equity need

tests.notes: Tests cover equity_need, final_score, URL-level candidate collapse, exclusion of already-selected URLs, and final score ordering.

features.notes: Reranking collapses duplicate chunk hits down to one best candidate per URL before scoring, which prevents a single article from occupying multiple slots during recommendation generation.

features.name: Async Ingestion Job Queue
features.description: Replace Celery with an in-process goroutine worker pool (4 workers, bounded per-URL fetch concurrency, 3 retries with backoff). API returns job_id; workers process in background.

tests.notes: Tests cover job creation, status tracking, progress reporting, and completion using miniredis.

subtasks: Add go-redis dependency for Redis job state management
Create goroutine worker pool (4 workers, per-URL concurrency from max_concurrent)
Create JobManager (generate job_id, track status/progress, store results in Redis)
Create worker task wrapping crawl -> build_link_graph -> ingest_article flow
Add GET /ingest/status/{job_id} and GET /ingest/result/{job_id} endpoints
Refactor POST /ingest/sitemap to enqueue job instead of running synchronously
Add Upstash REDIS_URL config var
features.notes: Fixes Render free-tier timeout for 150+ article sitemap ingests. Job lifecycle: queued -> processing -> retrying -> done/failed. Non-blocking enqueue returns 503 when the buffer is full. Pending jobs are reconciled on startup.

features.name: Dead Letter Queue
features.description: Store permanently failed ingestion jobs (after max retries) in a Redis-backed DLQ. Expose retry endpoint for manual reprocessing.

tests.notes: Tests cover DLQ push on failure, pop for retry, max retry exhaustion, and manual reprocessing using miniredis.

subtasks: Create DeadLetterQueue using Redis list dlq:ingest
Store failed job metadata: job_id, task_name, args, error, timestamp, retry_count
Configure worker with max_retries=3 and on_failure push to DLQ
Add POST /ingest/retry-dead endpoint to pop and re-enqueue failed jobs
features.notes: Failed jobs accumulate in DLQ for manual retry via API. A job reaches the DLQ only when the whole job fails (sitemap parse failure, enqueue failure, or every page failing); individual page failures are recorded on the job's errors list instead. Prevents silent whole-job data loss.

features.name: Goroutine Worker Pool
features.description: In-process goroutine worker pool (4 workers) replaces Celery. No separate deployment needed.

tests.notes: Worker pool is exercised indirectly through job manager integration tests.

subtasks: Create worker pool in cmd/server/main.go (starts with HTTP server, no separate process)
Configure concurrency: 4 workers; per-URL fetch concurrency from max_concurrent
Configure worker environment variables (MODELS_SPACE_URL, REDIS_URL, QDRANT_*, HF_TOKEN)
Set up Upstash Redis connection
No separate deployment needed -- worker pool runs in-process
features.notes: Worker pool runs in the same process as the HTTP server. No separate Render service or background worker. Job queue is an in-memory buffered channel, so queued jobs are lost on restart and recovered from Redis on startup.

features.name: External Keepalive (cron-job.org)
features.description: Scheduled cron job (every 10 min) pinging Render backend API, HF Models Space, and Qdrant Cloud to prevent free-tier sleep. Migrated from GitHub Actions to cron-job.org.

tests.notes: Manually verified via cron-job.org run history and curl exit codes.

subtasks: Create 3 cron-job.org jobs with */10 min schedule
Ping Render: GET https://autolinks.onrender.com/api/v1/health
Ping HF Space: GET https://eros483-autolinks-models.hf.space/
Ping Qdrant: GET https://<qdrant-host>:6333/collections with api-key header
features.notes: Free-tier services sleep after ~15 min of inactivity. Keepalive prevents cold-start penalty on real requests. External cron is more reliable than GitHub Actions scheduled workflows (which skip inactive repos). Replaces deleted .github/workflows/keepalive.yml.
